summary.text: Chris Fowler is the Democratic candidate for the Oklahoma House of Representatives, District 91, in the November 3, 2026 general election, where he faces Republican Roberto Luis Seda for an open seat.

A retired U.S. Air Force senior master sergeant, he said in a Ballotpedia survey that his priorities include strong public schools, affordable health care and wages that keep up with the cost of living.

paragraphs.text: Chris Fowler served in the U.S. Air Force from 2004 to 2024, earned a bachelor's degree from Southwestern College in 2013 and a graduate degree from the University of Maryland Global Campus in 2024.
In a Ballotpedia survey, he described himself as a retired Air Force Senior Master Sergeant and the father of two girls in Moore Public Schools.
In the survey, Fowler said he is running to continue serving as he did in the Air Force, by listening to people and taking action on their behalf.

He named strong public schools, affordable health care and paychecks that keep up with costs as his key messages, and said he is also passionate about updating zoning and building codes, using technology such as artificial intelligence for public benefit, and improving conditions for working people.
